title: Proration Credit of Prepaid TRICARE Prime Enrollment Fees
content:
When a fee-bearing **TRICARE Prime** enrollment ends for a credit-eligible reason, the paid enrollment fee for every whole calendar month after the disenrollment date is credited back, at one twelfth of the annual fee per month. A nonpayment disenrollment earns no credit.

## Clauses

1. **Amount.** The credit is the number of credited months multiplied by the annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement (the individual fee for an individual arrangement, the family fee for a family arrangement) and divided by 12, rounded to the cent once on the result. The credited months are the whole calendar months after the disenrollment date that fall inside the paid installment's coverage period.
2. **Condition:** a credit is posted only against an installment charge that has a payment posted against it, as the enrollment's fee account shows for that charge.
3. **Voluntary disenrollment** needs the beneficiary's own confirmation - the agent records the request and the beneficiary confirms it - and takes effect on the date confirmed, never earlier than the confirmation.

## Retired clauses

These clauses are **no longer in force**; they have been superseded by the current basis and are not applied:

- "the month in which the disenrollment date falls is never credited."
- "A credit is posted against the paid installment whose months are unused, once per installment and reason."
- "A credit that leaves the account with a credit balance is refunded through the method of the original payment within" the tier's refund issue days.

The figures in the table below remain valid.

## Figures by tier

| Tier | Proration unit | Credit-eligible reasons | Refund issue days |
|---|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member | calendar month | not applicable (fee-exempt) | 0 |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Service Member | calendar month | not applicable (fee-exempt) | 0 |
| TRICARE Prime Active Duty Family Member | calendar month | not applicable (fee-exempt) | 0 |
| TRICARE Prime Remote Active Duty Family Member | calendar month | not applicable (fee-exempt) | 0 |
| TRICARE Prime Transitional Survivor | calendar month | not applicable (fee-exempt) | 0 |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group A | calendar month | beneficiary disenrollment, loss of eligibility, region transfer, death of the beneficiary | 30 |
| TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B | calendar month | beneficiary disenrollment, loss of eligibility, region transfer, death of the beneficiary | 30 |

## Worked credits (hypothetical)

| Fee arrangement | Paid installment covers | Disenrollment date | Whole months after it inside the coverage | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Retiree Group A, individual (390.12) | January to December | 20 July | 5 (August to December) | 5 multiplied by 390.12, divided by 12: 162.55 |
| Retiree Group A, family (780.24) | January to December | 31 May | 7 (June to December) | 7 multiplied by 780.24, divided by 12: 455.14 |
| Any | April to June | 15 June | 0 | nothing |
| Any, disenrolled for nonpayment | - | - | - | no credit |

superseded_clauses: the month in which the disenrollment date falls is never credited.
A credit is posted against the paid installment whose months are unused, once per installment and reason.
A credit that leaves the account with a credit balance is refunded through the method of the original payment within fee_refund_issue_days.
